title: Village of Stouffville Ladies’ Night

description: Ladies’ Night on Main Street November 19 | 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM In The Village of Stouffville Grab your friends and get ready for a fabulous evening of shopping, dining, entertainment, prizes, and exclusive deals in the Village of Stouffville! Stroll along Main Street from Park Drive to just west of the GO Station and explore special offers, giveaways, and one-of-a-kind experiences from your favourite local shops and restaurants. Enjoy complimentary bites and bubbles at 19 on the Park, and celebrate a night dedicated to community and supporting local businesses. What to Expect ✨ Exclusive in-store promotions and giveaways 🍷 Special dining offers and treats 🛍️ Pop-up shops, demonstrations, and themed displays 🎶 Live entertainment and a festive atmosphere Tickets $15 per person All proceeds support the local food bank, helping families in our community. Ticket holders enjoy access to all Ladies’ Night exclusives throughout Main Street. Plus complimentary prosecco and a sweet treat when supplies last at19 on the Park! This is the perfect opportunity to treat yourself, get a head start on your holiday shopping, and experience the vibrant charm of Stouffville’s historic Main Street. Buy Tickets Here Participating Locations Include: 19 on the Park | 19 Civic Ave Get 15% off tickets to Coig: An East Coast Christmas on December 4 th Aji Kitchen | 6146 Main St. Treat your taste buds to a three-course prix fixe menu Back Alley Moto Cafe | 6393 Main St. All coffee drinks are 50% off during Ladies’ Night Chic Thrills | 6316 Main St. Calling all bag lovers! Preview 20 gorgeous bags and 4 wallets at our Bag Ladies Auction. Corner Spa | 6361 Main St. Stop by Corner Spa for some popcorn and a sparkly beverage, plus enjoy 20% off in-store purchases! Buy a gift card for any service during Ladies’ Night and receive 20% off that too! Fickle Pickle Restaurant | 6302 Main St. Enjoy a raffle of amazing gifts from six local vendors, special appetizers and a glass of wine for just $5.00, plus shop with the featured vendors! Francis & Meyer Candle Co. | 6290 Main St. Create something beautiful at Francis and Meyer’s Custom Gemstone Inlay Bar, design your own keepsake with sparkling gemstones. Then, explore the Lo & Co Luxe Jellwery pop-up and unwind at the Marshmallow World Hot Chocolate Lounge for a cozy treat! IDA | 6212 Main St. Enjoy 20% off all giftware during Ladies’ Night Lindy’s Floral | 6287 Main St. Enjoy 10% off your purchases during Ladies’ Night (excludes fresh flowers). Monas Merch | 6397 Main St. Add a little sparkle to your night! Take 10% off Avery’s handmade glass bead and gemstone bracelets. Mulligans | 6298 Main St. Stop by Mulligans during Ladies’ Night for delicious dishes, great company, and special offers for the evening! North & Co Studio Salon/Barbershop | 6235 Main St Unit C. Enjoy L’Oréal shampoo and conditioner samples, 15% off all products, and book your future blowout appointment at the event for only $25! Plus, explore fabulous pop-up shops inside! Pimento Jerk Kitchen | 6140 Main St. Plimento is offering an exclusive Ladies’ Night prix fixe menu featuring their signature Caribbean dishes. Redefined Finds & Foxglove Books | 6258 Main St. Enjoy sweet samples from a local artisan in our tasting area, plus receive a special gift with every ticket! It’s our way of saying thanks for joining us for Ladies’ Night. Renova Dental | 6284 Main St. Enjoy an evening of fun and festivity! Sip on a seasonal beverage, enter exciting raffles, and take part in exclusive giveaways Saints on Main | 6236 Main St. Stay a little longer and enjoy all our Ladies’ Night offers, with music, cocktails, and light bites available until 9PM! Sapori di Italia | 6331 Main St #61. Enjoy discounted muffins and loaves, plus a free espresso with any purchase! Springview Wellness | 6312 Main St. Try your luck with Spin the Wheel giveaways and exclusive Ladies’ Night deals! The Nock Academy | 10 Commercial St. Take a free Mat Pilates class and enjoy 25% off select services at Ladies’ Night. Trentadue Torres Group Keep the vibe going with a live DJ spinning tunes at Back Alley Moto Café! True Path Yoga & Pilates | 20 Freel Ln Unit 12. Join us for a complimentary class during Ladies’ Night! Choose between Barre Flow at 6:30PM or Slow Flow Yoga at 7:45PM. Spaces are limited. Participants must book in advance and complete our online waiver. Vivid Optical | 6292 Main St. Shine bright at Ladies’ Night with 25% off all sunglasses! Parking Information There is free street parking (up to three hours) along Main Street. Larger lots are also just a short walk away, including the Booth Drive Parking Lot (Booth Dr, Whitchurch-Stouffville, ON L4A 8B6) and 19 on the Park (19 Civic Ave). Presented by the Village of Stouffville.
